{{Quote|Her claws kill our foes and end our own lives in turn. Blessings to Kunik, who settles all scores.|Daily Prayer of the Trianii Rangers|<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>}}
'''Kunik''' was the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] goddess of bitter retribution and swift death. [[Trianii Rangers]] often followed her gloomy philosophies and prayed for her blessing.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
